policy.purpose: Candidate costing after an explicit inspection; not a damage predictor or return-to-service determination.
policy.replacement_comparison: Only calculate a replacement comparator when the inspection explicitly confirms that the dossier row is scope-comparable.
policy.material_rounding: Consumption allocation rounds up to the next cent. Cash purchase rounds required integer material units up to whole packages.
policy.measurements: Repair area/units and labor minutes are explicit integer inputs. The planner does not infer them from contact, damage flags, or component count.
policy.labor: DIY money rate is explicitly zero while time is retained. Paid labor rate is a planning scenario, not a market quote.
policy.applicability: Recipe candidates require an exact authored aircraft_id and economic component ID match. The map does not establish physical product compatibility, repair suitability or airworthiness. Unlisted foam, composite, P-51 and other components are not eligible.
